commits.message: fix(facts): a settle reads the lanes as declared now, a redeclaration is one turn, a cleared fault keeps its line, a recording is one follow's stream, one JSON-object predicate (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.go2)

fix(facts): the recording arm stands where the clock does, the recorder tells the log a line it could not write, the owners are read once per follow, and the draw reads the turn's closure (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.go2)
feat(facts): a view follows its session through the Facts interface, with an in-process arm, a recording arm and the seam test (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.go2)

feat(config)!: remove the env source; a config that declares one fails at load (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.2fe) (#623)

* feat(config)!: remove the env source; a config that declares one fails at load, naming file and shell as the expansion points (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.2fe)

One detached renderer draws for every session of its user, so its
environment is the shell that spawned it, never the session's: an env
variable was never a session fact. The kind, its loader arm, its field
spec, its renderer dispatch, the registry's declaration and the
environment threaded through the render cache for it all go. The loader
refuses `kind: "env"` through the retired-kind row the git kind already
uses, naming the variable it read and the two sources that remain.

The demo, the demo-variables example, the steel-thread fixture and the
probes fixture read the user and home through the payload instead. The
debug-introspection test exercises its declare-time lastError through
an input over a path the payload lacks, the only thing it used env for.

[LAW:polishing-by-subtraction] [LAW:one-source-of-truth] [LAW:no-silent-failure]

* fix(config): the retired env message names the payload input for HOME, USER, LOGNAME and HOSTNAME, and rules out echoing the variable from a shell source

Review fixes (high pass). The steel-thread fixture pins home as a literal
instead of an input the rig never feeds; the demo example's header stops
counting kinds; the probe patch's render.ts hunks drop the removed env arm;
the gap document says the env source is removed, present tense.

* fix(docs): the probe script and its README drop the env probe; the demo keys node --version on the branch and says the key makes the run the session's own

Review fixes (medium pass). The probe patch's blank context lines carry
their space again, so git apply parses it; the scope header stops listing
env; the retired replacement record is named for what it is, not for git.

## [1.193.0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.192.0...v1.193.0) (2026-11-06)

### Features

* **apply:** a click's launches are effects, performed after its turn and reported as effect-done (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.g2l) ([#621](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/621)) ([8bb9728](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/8bb9728f028615d94483db40d614a14926ef1468))

fix(load-gate): the budget check is unjudged under snapshots; the snapshot wait and NODE_OPTIONS form live in the lib; the fold's memory line states a consequence (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.c0y)
fix(scripts): a snapshot is matched by V8's name shape, the wait reuses sleep, NODE_OPTIONS is quoted; the fold's key comment says why the stamp is left out (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.c0y)

fix(load-gate): re-derive the budget from CI with every built-in placed (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.c0y)

Measured on PR #622's CI: 186 MB charged once collected at 20 sessions (feed criterion, feed off) and 514 MB at 100 (load gate). per-session = (514 - 186) / 80 = 4.1 MB, base = 186 - 20 * 4.1 = 104 MB, headroom a fifth as before. The gate placed neither metrics nor activity when the old 112 + 3.1 MB were measured.

fix(facts): one transcript fold in flight per session; the gate places every built-in and can snapshot its heap (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.c0y)

The 100-session gate failed with metrics and activity on because the
transcript fold started a new fold for every request of a session while
the session's first fold was still out, and a cold fold re-enters the
8-slot read gate once per window: folds arrived faster than any could
finish, none landed, the stamp fast path never engaged, and every
request's refresh stayed alive in the queue. The fold now coalesces per
session through the same SingleFlight the usage store's request refresh
uses.

The gate's config places metrics, activity, tokenSparkline and
autocompact, so it gathers every built-in the facts epic makes
always-on. `--heap-snapshots DIR` has the daemon write its heap at the
two collections through Node's signal snapshot; the whole-file wait
moves from capture-heap into scripts/lib and both call it.
test(facts): name the doctor's closure tests for what they protect (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)
fix(facts): the wait's comment names every session; the doctor's namespace-read test returns (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)

chore(facts): delete the wants closure (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)

The facts document is total, so the question "which fields does this config
read" has no caller with a reason. Every session now gathers every built-in:
git runs one constant option set (forge lookup included), every declared
plugin source is held, and burn, block and autocompact's context cap are always
composed. A view's declaration depends on the request alone, so a preset pick
moves no hold.

Deleted: the wants function, the needed-prefix builders, the sources-read walk,
the closure parameter through declare/refresh/read/project, the PR reads gate,
the git options derived from the closure, `Gathered`, `declaredSources`, and the
view's preset reaction. The doctor's data-needs walk stays and now owns its own
per-segment path closure, since it answers what a config would read.

The bar is byte-identical; the payload golden gains the keys that were gated
(block, burn, metrics, activity, tmux and the like on presets that did not read
them). Tests that asserted gating are deleted; the fold-edge cases they covered
(partials, helpers handed a dict) move to the doctor's path closure.
